overview: Updated tokens re-issued on OpenSea's shared storefront airdropped to og Genesis holders.
The distribution ran for eleven months, from August 2022 to June 2023: 638 sends to 265 wallets. Matched against what each recipient held at the moment their airdrop arrived:
- **824 of the 890 editions** went to wallets holding Genesis at the time
- **26** went to wallets that had held one earlier and sold in the meantime
- **40** went to wallets that never held one, most of those holding Coin Tokens or Beasties instead
- Only **13** reached wallets with no MetaZoo history at all
About 38.9 ETH (~$62,000) secondary volume and 1.79 ETH (~$4,500) of royalties flowed through since.
Holders were able to redeem a Neo Genesis promo card, an exclusive serialized MetaZoo card matching the Genesis NFT they held.
